title: MWLR Group Core Metadata Schema
description: Core metadata schema for Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao datasets, aligned to Dublin Core and Dublin Core Terms. Expressed in JSON Schema Draft-07.

required_metadata.title: Required metadata fields
required_metadata.description: List of required metadata fields for this MWLR Core Metadata Schema.

title.title: Title
title.description: A title giving an overview of the dataset.

description.title: Description
description.description: A descriptive abstract outlining the dataset.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: People and organisations involved in the creation, maintenance, or management of the dataset. Each entry must specify a role.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name of the person or organisation.

orcid.title: ORCID
orcid.description: ORCID identifier URI for the person (e.g. https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000).

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of this agent in relation to the dataset.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The organisation the agent is affiliated with.

dateCreated.title: Date Created
dateCreated.description: The date the dataset was created, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

identifier.title: Resource Identifier
identifier.description: A unique identifier for the dataset, preferably a DOI or other persistent URI.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords or phrases describing the dataset. Controlled vocabulary to be used should be GEMET.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: A keyword or phrase describing the dataset.

resourceType.title: Resource Type
resourceType.description: The nature or genre of the resource, from the DCMI Type Vocabulary. Limited subset used

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The entity responsible for publishing the dataset. Defaults to Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

general_metadata_information.title: Detailed metadata information
general_metadata_information.description: Additional metadata fields. These fields are not required but recommended for completeness.

alternativeTitle.title: Alternative Title
alternativeTitle.description: Alternative titles for the dataset. Use this field for te reo Māori titles or other variant names.

bibliographicNote.title: Bibliographic Note
bibliographicNote.description: Additional comments or bibliographic notes about the dataset.

note.title: Note
note.description: A bibliographic note or comment about the dataset.

dateModified.title: Date Modified
dateModified.description: The date the dataset was last modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Repeat for each version.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date the dataset was modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the dataset corresponding to this modification date.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language(s) of the resource. Use IETF BCP 47 language tags (e.g. 'en', 'mi' for te reo Māori).

temporalCoverage.title: Temporal Coverage
temporalCoverage.description: The time span the dataset covers.

start.title: Start Date
start.description: Start of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.title: End Date
end.description: End of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if ongoing.

description.title: Temporal Description
description.description: Free-text description of the temporal coverage where precise dates are not available.

spatialCoverage.title: Spatial Coverage
spatialCoverage.description: The spatial extent the dataset covers. Provide coordinates, place names, or both. Mandatory for spatial datasets.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry object describing the spatial extent.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates array. Structure depends on geometry type.

provenance.title: Provenance / Project Description
provenance.description: Information about the history or project context of the dataset, including project codes.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the provenance or project context. Can include project codes or other relevant details.

rightsHolder.title: Rights Holder
rightsHolder.description: The entity that holds rights over the dataset. Specify if not Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

license.title: License
license.description: The license under which the dataset is made available. Include any data sharing agreements.

accessRights.title: Access Rights
accessRights.description: Information about who can access the dataset, or its embargo status.

format.title: Format
format.description: The file format(s) of the dataset. If files use different file types use dominant type

format.title: Format
format.description: The file format of the dataset (e.g. 'CSV', 'GeoTIFF').

relation.title: Related Resources
relation.description: Resources related to this dataset, such as journal papers, methodology descriptions. Prefer URIs (e.g. DOIs).

relation.title: Description of Relation
relation.description: A description of the relationship to the related resource.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI identifying the related resource (e.g. DOI, URL).

isPartOf.title: Is Part Of
isPartOf.description: The collection or larger dataset this dataset belongs to (e.g. NZLRI).

collection.title: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the collection or larger dataset this dataset is part of.

uri.title: Collection URI
uri.description: A URI identifying the collection or larger dataset (e.g. DOI, URL).

source.title: Derived From / Source
source.description: A description of the resource or datasets from which this dataset was derived.

source.title: Source Description
source.description: A description of the source resource or dataset.

uri.title: Source URI
uri.description: A URI identifying the source resource or dataset (e.g. DOI, URL).

dataLocation.title: Location of Data
dataLocation.description: Where the data is stored. Should be updated when storage location changes.

location.title: Data Location
location.description: A description of the location where the data is stored.

uri.title: Location URI
uri.description: A URI identifying the location where the data is stored (e.g. DOI, URL).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: The intended audience or expected users of the dataset.

audience.title: Audience Description
audience.description: A description of the intended audience or expected users of the dataset.
